text:
release-lead: Heads-up: planned dependency upgrade (libvec v2.1) this Fri 22:00-23:30 PT. We're instituting a 90m partial embargo on the release train to reduce churn during the migration. Read the short plan below.

meera: Is this a full release freeze? or only for new canaries?

release-lead: Partial embargo only. Existing rollouts continue. New canaries that pull the upgraded artifact will be gated until health checks pass. Non-blocking deploys (docs, infra config) may proceed if they avoid the updated lib.

infra: Quick note: the upgrade requires a DB migration run as part of rollout. We'll run migration in a canary first, then promote. Migration is reversible but needs manual confirmation to promote to prod.

qa-lead: QA will schedule an extended smoke run at 22:10 PT. Please tag any candidate builds with `upgrade-libvec-v2.1` so we can filter.

release-lead: Good call. Risk/abort criteria for the canary (effective immediately):
- abort if error-rate (5xx) on canary hosts > 1.0% for 3m
- abort if end-to-end latency p95 increases > 25% vs baseline for 5m
- abort if DB migration errors > 0 in the canary migration job

tom: How do teams request exception for emergency fixes during embargo?

release-lead: File an exception in the release dashboard with justification and tag `embargo-exception`. Approvers are release-lead + infra. Emergency hotpatches allowed but must be marked and the oncall notified.

devops-bot: Reminder: Deploy dashboard ticket #DEP-3147 created for the upgrade. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and alerting group infra-escalation.

meera: Can we get a quick rollback command snippet for the runbook?

release-lead: Added this to the runbook snippet:```
# rollback canary and revert migration flag
rdeploy rollback --deploy-id DEPLOY_ID --reason "libvec-upgrade-fail"
# revert DB migration (runbook step)
kubectl exec -it migration-runner -- /scripts/revert_migration.sh MIG_ID
```

qa-lead: We'll prepare a condensed postmortem template for the upgrade window (2 sections: timeline & decision log). Keep it light.

infra: I'll be oncall Fri night and will coordinate the migration job. Posting a preflight checklist PR against infra-runbooks now.

release-lead: Thanks — we'll run the canary at 22:05, QA smoke at 22:10, and aim to open promotion at 22:45 if healthy. If any aborts occur, we hold promotion and triage immediately.

meera: A note for Dedicated customers: we will not forcibly evict pinned capacity. We'll prefer variant routing for affected workloads unless customer authorizes migration.

tom: ACK. I'll update customer-facing status page template in case we need to notify.

devops-bot: Preflight checks passing in CI. Will post final green at 21:30 PT.

release-lead: Final: block the 21:45-23:45 PT slot in calendars if you're on the release/pager list. See internal doc https://internal.docs/releases/libvec-upgrade for full details. Ping me DM for questions. :sparkles:
